brief:
A senior adviser to the US-led Board of Peace for Gaza told Middle East Eye that the panel will "throw the keys back to the UN" if Israel continues to obstruct its work. The Trump-appointed official did not elaborate on specific Israeli actions blocking the board's initiatives, according to the report.

The Board of Peace, established under the Trump administration, was tasked with developing postwar governance plans for Gaza. The threat to hand responsibility back to the United Nations signals potential friction between the US-led initiative and Israeli officials over the scope and pace of reconstruction and administrative efforts in the territory.
